installCommand: if [ ! -d "$HOME/flutter/bin" ]; then git clone --depth 1 -b stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"; fi; export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"; flutter config --no-analytics --enable-web; if [ -f pubspec.yaml ]; then flutter pub get; elif [ -f flutter/pubspec.yaml ]; then cd flutter && flutter pub get; else echo 'ERROR: pubspec.yaml not found' >&2; pwd; ls -la; exit 1; fi
buildCommand: export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"; if [ -f pubspec.yaml ]; then flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE=https://fctv33-api.kedidi-anis.workers.dev; elif [ -f flutter/pubspec.yaml ]; then cd flutter && flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE=https://fctv33-api.kedidi-anis.workers.dev; else echo 'ERROR: pubspec.yaml not found' >&2; exit 1; fi
